task_state_ref.description: Optional. Per-round pointer to the task-state directory under backlog/task-state/<task-id>/. Non-reviewer consumers (watcher, dispatcher, strategist) may use it to locate role-typed state. Reviewers MUST NOT read task_state_ref or its contents — fresh-eyes-at-SHA invariant is preserved by the validate.py REVIEWER_FRESH_EYES_VIOLATION check.

correlation_id.description: 057b — canonical uuid4 produced by request.py at request-write time. Shared by the watcher's coord_invoke spawn and the launchd-fallback wrapper so both paths close the daemon's pre-spawn reviewer_invoked deadline with the same key. r3 codex F2 MED — version-4 nibble + [89ab] variant byte enforced.
